title: Why Are We Moral? An LLM-based Agent Simulation Approach to the Study of Moral Evolution

layout.note: A full-width top band holds the agent architecture (Moral Types at left, Reflection above the plan and memory frames in the centre, Perception at right); a lower band holds the Social-Evol title and analysis assistant at left and the illustrated Environment at right; long arrows run between the two bands and a large pale block arrow runs from the Environment to the assistant.

lesson: Pair an agent's cognitive architecture, drawn as module cards with a few field lines, with an illustrated environment whose round types are written on the scene, and join them with two captioned arrows (action out, dynamics in). Nested rounded cards draw any ordered scope, such as circles of concern.
